## Agent Responsibilities

The following agents are expected to contribute to the resolution of this bug:

| Agent | Responsibility |
|-------|---------------|
| 🧑‍💻 **Developer** | Diagnose and fix the bug in `web-apps/` |
| 📝 **Doc-Writer** | Update docs if the bug reveals a documentation gap |
| 📡 **Telemetry-Engineer** | Verify or add telemetry to expose the issue |
| 🔒 **Security-Engineer** | Determine if the bug has security implications |
| ⚙️ **Automation-Engineer** | Update scripts/tasks if automation contributed to the issue |
| 🧪 **Test-Engineer** | Add a regression test to `web-app-tests/` |
| 🗄️ **Data-Engineer** | Provide reproduction data if needed |
| 👔 **Dev-Manager** | Review fix and verify it meets quality standards |
